### What I Cannot Verify From Here

- **Real device sign-in**: You need to install the APK and test login yourself. The code fixes are deployed and the backend is live, but I cannot tap the sign-in button on your phone.
- **Supabase Auth cold-start time**: The 45s timeout is generous enough for cold starts, but if Supabase takes longer than 45s, it will still abort. This is unlikely but not impossible.

**Install the APK from https://gofile.io/d/5OegXU and test sign-in. If it still aborts, screenshot the exact error and timestamp — I will trace it further.**
